# Petunia3D — Agent and Architectural Documentation

> Repository: https://github.com/WASDst/petunia3d
> Canonical branch: refactor/architecture-foundation
> Product: accessible low-poly/shape-first 3D editor for Linux/Windows. Slint + OpenGL 3.3 is target under explicit Go/No-Go.
> Do not assume implementation readiness from an approved ADR. Do not merge changes into main.

## Agent entrypoints

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/WASDst/petunia3d/blob/refactor/architecture-foundation/AGENTS.md): branch policy, boundaries and constraints.
- [Code Agent quickstart](docs/16-code-agents/index.md): reading order.
- [Authority and context navigation](docs/16-code-agents/reading-navigation.md): canonical vs legacy.
- [Implementation protocol](docs/16-code-agents/implementation-protocol.md): gap matrix, commits and gates.
- [Domain playbooks](docs/16-code-agents/domain-playbooks.md): which docs/roles to read.
- [Prompt library](docs/16-code-agents/prompt-library.md): reusable prompts.
- [Orchestration](docs/16-code-agents/agent-orchestration.md): role selection, least privilege.
- [Evidence and handoffs](docs/16-code-agents/evidence-handoffs.md): truthful status and next steps.

## Navigation

- [Implementation tracking protocol](docs/17-reimplementation/index.md): mandatory status/checkpoint updates with each implementation.
- [Versioned tasks](progress/tasks.json): single source for TODO / IN PROGRESS / DONE; percentages derive from evidenced checkpoints.

- [Full website manifest](docs/manifest.json): all registered Markdown docs.
- [Human documentation home](docs/home.md): site starting point.

The historical docs/bible tree and egui/WGPU policy do not override decisions in website/docs on this branch. Source code and tests determine actual implementation status. Prumo files are external references, not automatically installed or authorized.
